summary: Updated implementation plan artifact for Guardrail OS: reflecting completed Phase 4 (Persistence & Multi-Tenancy via Firebase & atomic local storage), Phase 5 (Formal Verification & Developer Tools), Phase 6 (PEP Fleet, L-SFS CoW Filesystem, MicroVM Sandboxes, AuthZEN/SPIFFE standard, and Closed-Loop Autopilot), alongside a formal language security & performance evaluation (Python vs. Rust/Go for safety kernels).
